name: Hate
overview: Scripture distinguishes between righteous hatred and sinful hatred, teaching believers not to harbor hatred toward fellow humans but to hate evil itself. Leviticus 19:17 commands against hating a brother in the heart, urging correction instead, while Psalms 97:10 and Proverbs 8:13 emphasize that those who love the Lord hate evil and its manifestations. The Lord’s hatred is directed toward specific sins such as pride, arrogance, and lying (Proverbs 6:16; 10:18), highlighting that love covers sins whereas hatred breeds strife (Proverbs 10:12). Thus, biblical hate is rooted in a holy fear of God that rejects sin without condemning the sinner.
